name: Jamal Nasir
headline: Finance, mathematics and machine learning — put to work.
intro: I move between financial risk, economic research and building models. My work spans electricity markets, agriculture, credit, international trade and language models: finding the question, working through the mathematics, and building something that can be tested and used.
current: Consultant · EY MENA · ECL Valuation & Assurance

points: Working on forecasting and expected credit loss (ECL) models for assurance and valuation engagements, reporting to the Partner.
Conducted transaction evaluations and supported offer letters and guarantees for PKR 1.5bn with HBL Microfinance Bank and PKR 4.0bn with Bank Alfalah.
Developed ISMO-based electricity-price guarantee research and simulations for The price of a promise, connecting fixed prices, buyer contributions, reserve sizing and guarantor exposure.
Built and deployed Pakistan export intelligence to automate recurring analysis; worked on the LUMS-MAF returnable guarantee facility for the swappable battery programme.
Led Phase 2 development work for the Guarantee Management Portal, standardising data fields and reporting protocols across financial institutions.
Managed credit evaluations for a 24-entity portfolio, primarily in energy and construction, analysing capital structure, liquidity, coverage and cash flows.

experience.organization: Project Indigenous Mechanization · Government of Punjab
points: Worked with Dr. Shakeel Sadiq Jajja on indigenous e-mechanisation; engaged 50+ farmers, manufacturers and financial-sector stakeholders to understand adoption barriers and opportunities.
Co-developed IBA’s five-year strategic plan across seven pillars, designed accreditation-aligned KPIs, and supported data modelling and institutional performance dashboards.
Served as an independent ML consultant to Ireland-based clients, delivering production-grade forecasting and classification systems.
Built differential-equation models for Irish cattle–land saturation forecasting; mentored the team on an MNIST classification pipeline.
Generated more than €7,000 in consulting revenue to date.

projects.title: The price of a promise
projects.description: What does it cost to fix electricity prices for a year? I developed research and a simulation model using ISMO demand and marginal-cost profiles to compare fixed-price choices, buyer contributions and the guarantor’s exposure when reserves are depleted.
projects.methods: Historical replay · Scenario simulation · Reserve sizing

projects.title: Pakistan export intelligence
projects.description: Built and deployed an interactive application that replaces repeated manual analysis with a view of Pakistan’s product mix, exporter concentration and market opportunities.

projects.title: TinyLlama: fine-tuning and alignment
projects.description: Fine-tuned the 1.1-billion-parameter TinyLlama model using LoRA and Direct Preference Optimization, evaluating instruction-following and question-answering behaviour on custom datasets.

projects.title: Derivative pricing & Monte Carlo simulation
projects.description: Implemented Black–Scholes and Heston models in Python, and benchmarked Monte Carlo option-pricing simulations on NSE market data against Black–Scholes outputs.

projects.title: Loan servicing risk alerts
projects.description: Designed early-warning models to flag high-risk microfinance clients, identified predictive features and supported the workflow design for model deployment.

projects.title: Optimisation in high dimensions
projects.description: Reviewed optimisation techniques and their mathematical derivations, then built and ran multiple models for high-dimensional logistic regression.
